svg.text: How the Console runs a command
The editor holds no knowledge of ws-host
Handshake: command list gives commands, titles, icons and views, and the schema is
Rows: the list command of each noun fills the trees, with a status turned into an icon
A write runs --dry-run first, and its changes open as a diff
A decision also needs a modal that returns exactly true
Then the real run, and the result is drawn from JSON
